literal_description: A white four-story corner building with beige horizontal stripe bands and a natural stone-clad ground floor housing a small shop, standing at a street corner in a small German half-timbered old town. Cobblestone alleys on all sides, a narrow alley beside the building with half-timbered neighboring houses, the rear facade with a gravel patch, trees and waste bins, street lanterns along the street.
environment: Small German old town, street corner with narrow cobblestone alleys, neighboring half-timbered houses, distant church tower
visual_style: Photorealistic, faithful to the source photographs
lighting: Soft autumn daylight, partly cloudy sky with blue patches
